claims: Issue #666 reports nineteen packings beyond n = 324 with sides below the record of 17 October 2026: s(464) <= 21.988813022694, below Couzo's certificate of 14 October 2026, and at 509, 555, 603, 654, 706, 760, 817, 875, 935, 998, 1061, 1128, 1196, 1266, 1339, 1413, 1489 and 1568 sides below the integer grid ceil(sqrt n), each rounded up at 12 places from the exact side in line 1 of nNNNN.cert.

The packings use the staircase-rectangle and four-block method of Arslanov, Mustafin and Shangitbayev (Electron. J. Combin. 28(4), P4.22, 2021); the n = 464 packing uses a six-square patch from the author's n = 422 construction. No optimality, rigidity or local-minimum claim.

check.py (Python standard library, exact rationals) checks every corner strictly inside the container and every pair with centres closer than sqrt(2) separated along an edge normal; the source reports it accepts all nineteen and that the JSON poses pass the same test at 80 digits. Acquisition does not run it or establish checker independence.
